# Newtuple Technologies

> > AI-first data company delivering enterprise AI agents, LLM evaluation platforms, and data intelligence solutions on AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Newtuple Technologies specializes in generative AI accelerators, agentic automation, and conversational BI platforms. The company offers products like Gaugetuple (LLM monitoring), Omnituple (conversational BI), and domain-specific AI agents for recruitment, PMO, revenue, and finance operations.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents & Agentic Architecture
- Generative AI & Enterprise AI
- LLM Evaluation & Monitoring
- Data Intelligence & Transformation
- Conversational AI & BI
- AWS, Azure, GCP Deployment
- OpenAI, Gemini, LLaMA Models
- Kubernetes, Docker, Helm
- dbt, Meltano, DuckDB
- Natural Language to SQL
- Prompt Engineering
- ATS Integration (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors)
- Pub/Sub Pipelines (Kafka, Azure Service Bus)
- Self-Hosted AI Solutions
- GenAI Accelerators

## AI Products & Platforms

- [Gaugetuple | Newtuple](https://www.newtuple.com/gaugetuple): LLM evaluation platform for continuous monitoring across OpenAI, Anthropic
- [Omnituple | Newtuple](https://www.newtuple.com/omnituple): Self-hosted conversational BI with Kubernetes deployment and LLM integration
- [Agents as a Service | Newtuple](https://www.newtuple.com/genai-powered-business-automation): Gen AI business automation with Revenue Agent and Finance Guardian products
- [Recruitment Agents_main | Newtuple](https://www.newtuple.com/hiring-agents): AI hiring agents with ATS integration for Workday, SAP SuccessFactors
- [PMO Agents | Newtuple](https://www.newtuple.com/pmo-agents): PMO Intelligence Suite for AI-powered project and portfolio management
